name: WellSaid Labs
positioning: WellSaid is a voiceover studio for teams producing finished narration, with a separate REST text-to-speech API whose pricing is quoted on request.

pricing.model: Studio: monthly or annual subscriptions metered by downloaded minutes of finished audio (generation is unlimited on paid plans). API: priced by monthly character quota with overages, rates not published.
pricing.headline: No public per-character API price. Studio plans start at USD 10 per month billed annually (240 downloaded minutes per year) or USD 19 per month billed monthly (20 minutes per month).
pricing.headlineTier: Not published: WellSaid's FAQ says API usage is charged by monthly character quota plus overages, but rates are not on its public pages

tiers.name: Trial (Studio)
tiers.notes: No commercial rights on the trial.

tiers.name: Starter (Studio)
tiers.unit: USD 10 per month billed annually (USD 120/year, 240 minutes/year) or USD 19 per month billed monthly (20 minutes/month)
tiers.notes: All English voices, full commercial rights, 10 projects, 24 kHz, MP3.

tiers.name: Pro (Studio)
tiers.unit: USD 33 per month billed annually (USD 396/year, 2,160 minutes/year) or USD 49 per month billed monthly (180 minutes/month)
tiers.notes: Unlimited projects, up to 48 kHz, Adobe Express integration; extra minutes can be bought in Studio.

tiers.name: Business (Studio)
tiers.unit: USD 160 per user per month billed annually (USD 1,920/year, 2,880 minutes/year/user)
tiers.notes: Up to 5 seats, team workspace, invoicing.

tiers.name: Enterprise (Studio and API)
tiers.notes: Custom minutes and seats, all languages, translation, SSO, SOC 2 reports, up to 96 kHz. Contact sales.

pricing.freeTier: Free studio trial (3 download minutes per month, no commercial rights); a free 7-day API trial key is offered.
promotions: Annual billing is shown as saving 47% (Starter) and 33% (Pro) versus monthly on the pricing page; no end date is stated. Pricing is stated to apply to new customers.

voices.count: Over 200 combinations of voices and styles (docs FAQ); the stream endpoint accepts about 145 speaker_id values
voices.languages: English voices on all plans; global voices (Arabic, Chinese, Czech, Danish, Dutch, French and more, many provided by partners) listed in the API docs; Studio lists all languages as an Enterprise feature

streaming.vendorStatedLatency: Vendor-stated: fastest render speed 'approximately 500ms per 30 characters' (API FAQ); streaming endpoint recommended for low latency.

formats: Studio exports: MP3, WAV, OGG, TXT, SRT/VTT captions (plan-dependent)

compatibility.note: WellSaid uses its own schema: POST https://api.wellsaidlabs.com/v1/tts/stream with an X-Api-Key header and numeric speaker_id. SSML support is limited (say-as) and enabled with an X-Enable-SSML header.

licensing.commercialUse: Full commercial rights on paid Studio plans; the free trial has no commercial rights.
licensing.attributionOrConditions: API-specific licence terms were not found on pages read; content moderation applies.

limits.concurrency: Default API key: 3 requests per second; higher limits by arrangement

sdks: REST API with a sample React app and an MCP server (no official language SDKs found in the docs index)

compliance.note: Self-attested on wellsaid.io/security: GDPR, SOC 2 Type I and Type II; data hosted in the U.S. on Google Cloud; customer data not used to train models. wellsaid.io/api also states 'SOC2 and GDPR compliant'. HIPAA not mentioned on pages read.

strengths.claim: Closed-model voices from contracted voice actors, with commercial rights included on paid plans.
API offers async clip creation, word timing with subtitle output, replacement libraries for pronunciation, and an AI Director control for pitch, pace and tone.
Studio output up to 96 kHz on Enterprise and 48 kHz on Pro.
Security posture stated: GDPR, SOC 2 Type I and II, no training on customer data.
Global voice list spans many languages, including Arabic, Mandarin, Cantonese and several European languages (partner-provided voices).

limitations.claim: Public pages state a 1,000-character request limit and a default of 3 requests per second per API key.
Studio plans meter downloaded minutes and unused minutes do not roll over.
Limited SSML: the documented tag is say-as.

stepsToMove: Request an API key (a 7-day trial is available) and note that WellSaid authenticates with an X-Api-Key header.
Swap the endpoint: POST https://api.wellsaidlabs.com/v1/tts/stream with text (1 to 1,000 characters), numeric speaker_id and optional model ('legacy' or 'caruso').
Map each speaker_id to a voice on the target service using the avatars list (GET avatars endpoint).
Translate SSML (say-as only, via the X-Enable-SSML header) and replacement libraries (pronunciation respellings) to the target's pronunciation controls.
If you use async clips, word timing or clip combining with pauses, replace those workflows separately.

bestFor: Corporate training, marketing and L&D teams who want polished studio voiceover and a managed API from the same vendor, and who are comfortable with sales-quoted API pricing.
